predictions: P-A1 (census prior, BLACKBODY, union rule): the archival prior gives ZERO blocks passing the union rule (LRT_BANDBB_BAND >= 9.2 AND kT > 1.05 keV) OR (LRT_CPLBB_CPL >= 9.2 AND kT > 1.05 keV). Max LRT_BANDBB_BAND = 3.66 and that block is a zero-width artifact; max over PHYSICAL blocks = 2.43 (blk4). Max LRT_CPLBB_CPL = 2.06 (blk4). PREDICTION: the new fits give AT MOST 1 significant-BB block, most likely 0. FALSIFIED IF: >= 2 blocks pass the union rule.

P-A2 (census prior, MODEL MENU): AIC winners stay inside the single-curvature family (CPL or Band) in >= 80% of finite-width blocks, and the time-integrated block is won by Band or CPL. FALSIFIED IF: a BB-composite or DSBPL wins the time-integrated block, or if single-curvature models win fewer than 80% of finite-width blocks.

P-A3 (census prior, TWO-BREAK watch): archival max LRT_DSBPL_SBPL = 4.02 (blk4, 42.8-110.0 s), integrated 2.71 - all far below the DeltaAIC >= 10 gate. PREDICTION: with the hardened engine (L18 default-seed DSBPL restart, L19 widened Ep caps) DSBPL stays SUB-threshold in EVERY block. FALSIFIED IF: DSBPL wins any block at DeltaAIC >= 10. Note the campaign doctrine that archival two-break counts are LOWER limits applies with full force here - this prediction is the one most exposed to the hardening.

P-A4 (BOUND_CAPPED, L19): the archival Band high-energy index runs -3.58, -3.56, -4.14, -5.00 across blocks and SBPL_BETA sits at the -5.0 floor in EVERY block, while the published catalog measures a well-constrained beta = -2.585 +/- 0.130 over a 798 s interval with 4 detectors. PREDICTION: with widened bounds, at least one block is diagnosed BOUND_CAPPED on the high-energy index, and the time-integrated Band beta comes out steeper than -2.4. FALSIFIED IF: the integrated Band beta is HARDER than -2.2 (which would mean the archival railing was a seed/bound artifact rather than a real absence of a high-energy tail in our 112 s window), or if no block is bound-flagged despite an index within 0.05 of a bound.

P-A5 (BINNING, per-bin-coverage): the archival binning produced SIX rows of which TWO are zero-width degenerate blocks (blk1 = 20.69634 -> 20.69977 s, width 3.4 ms; blk3 = 42.796193 -> 42.796210 s, width 1.7e-5 s), carrying nonsensical negative AIC and VALID=False everywhere. PREDICTION: the 3ML Bayesian-Blocks + significance-merge binner produces 3-8 FINITE-width blocks over the stamped window and ZERO zero-width blocks. FALSIFIED IF: any block has width < 0.05 s, or if the block count falls outside 3-8.

P-B1 (LITERATURE, Bordoloi, Mittal & Iyyani 2026, 2026ApJ..1003...58B - the ONLY refereed paper on this burst): GRB 120905657 passes their INITIAL time-integrated + peak-flux cuts (fluence 1.96e-5 > 1e-5 erg/cm2; flnc Band alpha = -0.2516 > -0.5; flnc Band beta = -2.585 in (-1.7,-3.3); pflx Band alpha = -0.0139 > -0.45; pflx Band beta = -2.538 in (-1.7,-3.3)) and was then EXCLUDED at the time-resolved stage. Figure 10 caption, p.17, verbatim: 'A few representative GRBs that were excluded from the initial sample because their time-resolved Band alpha and beta did not meet the selection criteria.' Their gate: >= ~80% of Bayesian-Block bins inside the T70 region (15%-85% of cumulative background-subtracted counts) must satisfy alpha > -0.45 AND -1.7 > beta > -3.3. PREDICTION: in our time-resolved Band fits, FEWER than 80% of blocks satisfy both criteria simultaneously; and the FAILING parameter is beta (too steep, running past -3.3), NOT alpha - because the archival prior has alpha in [-0.19, -0.45] (all at or above their alpha gate) while beta runs -3.56 to -5.00 (all past their beta floor). FALSIFIED IF: >= 80% of our blocks satisfy both criteria (their exclusion would then be irreproducible), OR if the failures are driven by alpha rather than beta (we would then be reproducing their verdict for the wrong reason - the L26 'right answer, wrong mechanism' trap).

P-B2 (LITERATURE/CATALOG, frame-aligned curvature): the GBM catalog time-integrated Comptonized fit gives Ep = 91.797 +/- 2.776 keV (nuFnu peak, -4.096 to 794.230 s, detectors n9+na+nb+b1, Castor C-STAT). The archival prior's integrated CPL converts, in the SAME convention, to Ep = (2 + index) * xc = (2 - 0.3233) * 54.5865 = 91.5 keV - agreement to 0.3% despite a 7x shorter interval and a different detector set. PREDICTION: our new integrated CPL curvature energy Ep = (2 + index) * xc lands in 80-105 keV. FALSIFIED IF: outside 70-120 keV.

P-B3 (LITERATURE/CATALOG, SPECTRAL EVOLUTION): the catalog's peak-interval Comptonized Ep = 101.263 +/- 12.908 keV (12.288-13.312 s) versus its time-integrated Comptonized Ep = 91.797 +/- 2.776 keV - a ratio of only 1.10 +/- 0.15 in the SAME model family, i.e. almost no integrated-vs-peak hardness contrast across a 195 s burst. The archival prior agrees: Band Ep = 103.8 (0.5-20.7 s) -> 78.2 (20.7-42.8 s) -> 86.2 (42.8-110.0 s) keV, non-monotonic and spanning only 1.33x. PREDICTION: our block-resolved Ep varies by LESS than a factor 2 across finite-width blocks and is NOT monotonically decreasing; this is a weak-evolution / intensity-tracking-like burst, not a strong hard-to-soft one. FALSIFIED IF: Ep spans more than a factor 3 across blocks, or falls monotonically by more than 2.5x.

P-C1 (COVERAGE, D4 - a statement about what our window can and cannot see): the stamped window [-2, +110] s covers 112 s of a T90 that runs -7.168 -> +188.419 s (50-300 keV). Quick-look CSPEC 50-300 keV net counts (degree-2 polynomial background on the CATALOG background windows; indicative, NOT the production estimator) put 81.4% (n9) / 87.3% (na) of the burst inside our window, 14.6%/9.0% in 110-200 s, and 4.0%/3.7% in -10..-2 s. PREDICTION: our summed block exposure is 112 s and any T90-like or fluence-like number we derive is a PARTIAL-COVERAGE quantity ~10-20% below the catalog's TOTAL-coverage value; it must never be diffed against the catalog T90/fluence without that label (T9). FALSIFIED IF: our derived window fluence exceeds the catalog 10-1000 keV fluence (1.95674e-5 erg/cm2), which would indicate a background or response error rather than a coverage effect.

Treat blk4's archival numbers as the softest part of the prior.
